description: GNN rollout prediction on central 217-column Flyvis data, experiment 2, arm cond_l25 (group lasso 25 on g_phi input groups), fold cv00, model flyvis_conductance (g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)), embedding dim 2, model noise sigma 0.0, 1 epoch, batch 4, data augmentation loop 500, one-step training, fp32 MLP precision; regularisers W_L1 7.5e-05, W_L2 7.5e-07, g_phi input group L1 25.0, g_phi weight L1 0.14, f_theta weight L1 0.025; 15 of 15 runs landed, panels for noise_free, noise_005, noise_05 (model noise sigma 0, 0.05, 0.5). Top row: rollout traces for 12 cell types over 1,000 frames at ∆t = 20 ms (20 s), green ground truth, black prediction, red photoreceptor input. Bottom row: rollout vs ground-truth voltage as log-density image pooled over all neuron-frame pairs of the 7,207-frame held-out rollout, with per-neuron Fisher-z pooled Pearson r.
facts:
CAPTION: Rollout prediction. General-form GNN (group lasso 25) evaluated on central 217-column Flyvis data under three model noise regimes (σ = 0, σ = 0.05, σ = 0.5; fold cv00 of experiment 2), tested on held-out stimuli, and compared against the noise-free Flyvis simulation of the same stimuli. Top row (a, b, c): GNN rollout traces for 12 representative cell types over a 20 s window (1,000 frames at ∆t = 20 ms). Green: noise-free ground-truth voltage; black: GNN rollout prediction; red: the visual input of the photoreceptor row. Bottom row (d, e, f): rollout voltage against noise-free ground-truth voltage, pooled over all (neuron, frame) pairs of the 7,207-frame rollout (the fold’s held-out stimuli) as a log-density image. Pearson r: per-neuron, Fisher-z pooled, on the full rollout.
FACTS:
- experiment: 2: GNN MLP(ai,aj,vi,vj), group lasso, model noise
- arm: cond_l25
- runs: 15 of 15 landed
- cells: noise: noise_free, noise_005, noise_05
- dataset: flyvis_noise_free_blank50_cv00
- model: flyvis_conductance
- embedding dim: 2
- model noise sigma: 0.0
- epochs: 1
- batch: 4
- data augmentation loop: 500
- training: one-step
- MLP precision: fp32
- regularisers: W_L1 7.5e-05, W_L2 7.5e-07, g_phi_input_group_L1 25.0, g_phi_weight_L1 0.14, f_theta_weight_L1 0.025
GLOSSARY (meaning of identifier fragments; use only these):
- blank50: in every video clip of the stimulus, the first 50% of the frames are replaced by blank frames
- cv00 .. cv04: cross-validation folds 0 to 4
- noise_free / noise_005 / noise_05: model noise sigma 0 / 0.05 / 0.5
- 010 / 020 after noise_005: measurement noise gamma 0.1 / 0.2
- flyvis_conductance: code name of the general-form GNN, g_phi = MLP(a_i, a_j, v_i, v_j)
- flyvis_known_ode: code name of the Known-ODE model (the generator's equation with learned W, tau, V_rest)
- condl25 / condl100: group lasso 25 / 100 on g_phi's input groups
- null_edges_pc_400 / null400: 400% extra null edges added to the connectome
- removed_pc_20 / rm20, removed_pc_50 / rm50: 20% / 50% of the edges removed
- hidden_020 / hid20, hid10: 20% / 10% of the neurons hidden
- s5h06 / s5h21: one frame in five observed, rollout horizon 6 / 21
- INR_davis: stimulus not given, learned by a SIREN network
- full_eye_flywireRF / e8_flywireRF: FlyWire eye / e8 hybrid connectome; proximal_nulls: with proximal null edges
